parsed.note: The proposed changes (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 524288→262144, and a later MATRIX_LR bump to 0.10) only tune training hyperparameters and leave the fixed evaluation block and shard 10 untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality; the claim of keeping DEPTH=6 conflicts with the current DEPTH=4 but is a reporting inconsistency, not evaluation gaming.
